title: Fix Flow Text Appearance Colors
description: Flow text does not adjust to appearance — on dark mode it still has dark text. Fix WASM canvas hosts (FlowGraphCanvasHost, WasmEditorSurface, WasmGraphSurface) to sync canvas theme via useCanvasAppearanceSync + syncSessionCanvasTheme + renderFrame(), matching the puzzle/note pattern.
summary: Fixed the real Flow dark-text bug: node/port labels on the HTML Canvas2D overlay were painted with unresolved CSS var() fillStyles, which Canvas silently treats as black. Labels now resolve to appearance-aware hex via dagOverlayLabelFillHex/resolveColorHex; color-resolve caching and headless foreground fallbacks also follow html.dark.
